title: Iya Tobi
brief: Shina has taken Tunde's mother to force him out. Their car is leaving Oshoja now. Go after it.
standout: A car chase out of Oshoja, and your mother at the end of it.

say.speaker: Oshoja Junction
lines: Neighbour: Túndé! Wọ́n ti gbé màmá ẹ lọ! Mọ́tò dúdú, ọkùnrin mẹ́ta!  (Tunde! They have taken your mother! A black car, three men!)
Shina (on the phone): You hold my bag, conductor. I hold your mother.
Baba Sule: Wọ́n ń sá lọ sí etí omi. Stilt Town. Yára!  (They are running to the waterside. Stilt Town. Hurry!)

objectives.sub: To the waterside before they reach the boats
objectives.late: They reached the boats with her.

objectives.text: Cross the water to the hideout

sayDone.speaker: Stilt Town Waters
lines: Iya Tobi: Túndé. Mo sọ fún wọn pé wàá wá.  (Tunde. I told them you would come.)
Tunde: Màmá, a ń lọ.  (Mama, we are going.)
Baba Sule: I get people for Ibadan. She go stay there till this thing finish.
